Because their cash flows are reliable year after year, a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model works very well. EV/EBITDA smooths out some of this distortion by looking at earnings before interest and tax, making it a fairer comparison across the economic cycle. Price-to-Sales is also useful as revenue tends to be more stable than profits for cyclical businesses.
